title: vulneraria cornicina
intro: Vulneraria cornicina, commonly known as Bearberry or Uva-ursi, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to Europe and Asia, belonging to the family Rubiaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate urinary tract issues and boost the immune system. The vulneraria cornicina plant contains several bioactive constituents, including arbutin, ursolic acid, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and antioxidant effects. Additionally, vulneraria cornicina has been traditionally used for its antidiarrheal and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable herb in folk medicine.
